title: Mixing: One Hand Clapping by Wings | 1974
content:
Studio Two, EMI Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Geoff Emerick

A mixing session for the audio of Wings’ film One Hand Clapping was held on 28 September 1974.

This was the fourth of five consecutive days spent mixing the audio to be used in the film.
